name: 43938 · Mingo Jct, OH
findings: ZIP 43938 (Mingo Jct) has 12 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 5 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (60% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 43938 (Mingo Jct) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
